name: io.github.New1Direction/trust-oracle
description: Agent-callable MCP trust oracle. Returns an independent A–F trust grade for any MCP server (spec conformance, security/OWASP-MCP-Top-10, reliability, tool hygiene, transparency), checks for tool-surface drift / rug-pulls, and gates a connection with a single connect/caution/avoid verdict BEFORE an agent executes. The grade is free and never for sale.
